text:
A: Hiya! Oh, look at this, two Traceys. I'm Tracey, obviously. Chelmsford.
B: Yeah. Tracey. Dagenham.
A: Dagenham! Oh, I'm Basildon originally, so we're practically neighbours. My dad used to do jobs all round there. He was a plumber, self-employed, did really well for himself.
B: Right. My dad was at Ford's.
A: Oh, everyone's dad was at Ford's, weren't they? Half my school had someone there. So what do you do, hun?
B: Cleaning. Offices, in Romford. Evenings.
A: Oh, right, so you're off out after this? I'm a fitness instructor, spin, circuits, PT. I was in recruitment for nearly twenty years before that, branch manager, and then I retrained at forty-five. Best thing I ever did, honestly.
B: Yeah?
A: Yeah. I mean, the money was good in recruitment, don't get me wrong, but you're stuck behind a desk, aren't you? Now I'm on my feet all day and I love it.
B: I'm on my feet all night. Don't love it.
A: Ha! Fair enough, to be fair. Is it hard going?
B: It's alright. Bins, kitchen, toilets. Supervisor's on my back. Same as anywhere, d'you know what I mean.
A: Oh, I know that one. When I managed the branch I had a couple of girls who thought I was on their backs, and I was, I'll be honest, because the targets don't hit themselves, do they?
B: Well, I'm not on targets, I just clean.
A: No, no, I know. I just mean, I've been the manager, so I see both sides, you know?
B: Mm.
A: So do you do anything for yourself? Exercise, anything?
B: I walk the dog. Did Zumba once, community centre. Six weeks.
A: Oh, why'd you stop? Zumba's great fun.
B: There was this woman. Kept stood right in front of me every week, like she owned the spot. I said something and she went all funny and the instructor took her side. So I didn't go back.
A: Oh, that's rubbish, that should never happen. In my classes I'd have sorted that in two seconds. Everyone gets the same treatment. You should come to one of mine if you're ever out my way.
B: Chelmsford? On the bus? No chance.
A: Ha, I'll pick you up in the Evoque!
B: Course you will.
A: What about holidays, are you a holiday person? I'm off to Marbella in the summer with the girls, we go every year, Puerto Banús, sunbed, cocktails on the marina. I've done Dubai twice as well, loved it.
B: We do Tenerife if we can. Or Clacton. Depends what's in the bank.
A: Oh, Clacton, I haven't been to Clacton since I was a kid. Is it still the same?
B: Pretty much. The caravans are alright. It's cheap and Duchess can come. That's the dog.
A: Aw, what is she?
B: Staffy. Old girl now. Her back legs are going.
A: Oh bless her. You know they do hydrotherapy for dogs now? One of my clients takes her Labrador, swears by it.
B: How much is that, then?
A: Erm, I think about forty quid a session, something like...
